note: The Media desk's configuration — which platforms show as destinations in Admin -> Media, and the press list for one-tap releases. IMPORTANT: this file is public (every data file is), so it holds names and choices only — NEVER an API key, stream key, or token. The actual posting happens through the automation layer (config.json webhookUrl -> n8n on the church's own box, or Zapier/Make/Ayrshare), and the actual multi-platform live fan-out happens on the streaming box (scripts/appliance/mediamtx.yml). docs/MEDIA-SUITE.md is the honest per-platform guide.

pressContacts.note: Fill in the church's real local media list: paper, TV assignment desks, radio, community calendars. The office owns this list; the app just sends to it.

liveDestinationsNote: Where the service streams simultaneously is configured on the streaming box (stream keys are secrets and live ONLY there) — see scripts/appliance/mediamtx.yml and docs/MEDIA-SUITE.md. List the active ones here by name if you want the Media desk to display them.
